title: Bids
description: View and manage bids on task requests.

help.title: About bids
help.overview: A bid is a quote on a client's task request: your price, the days you need and a short proposal. When the client accepts one, the task is awarded and an order opens.

sections.title: Each bid
items: You can bid once on each open request posted by someone else.
A bid can't be edited: withdraw it with Reject bid and send a new one.
Accept bid turns the other bids down and opens an order with the bid's price and a due date from its days. Everyone who bid is told.
Bids are private: you see your own bids and the bids on your own requests, never a competitor's.
